user.title: Configure Crestron DM NVX Device
user.description: Add a Crestron DM NVX transmitter or receiver. Role (transmitter/receiver) is detected automatically from the device.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Crestron DM NVX
reconfigure.description: Update the connection to the same physical NVX device. Enter its password to verify the changes.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Crestron DM NVX
reauth_confirm.description: The device rejected the saved credentials. Enter working credentials to reconnect.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Please check the IP address and network connection.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid username or password. Please check your credentials.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
error.invalid_host: Enter only an IP address or hostname, without https:// or a port.
error.invalid_name: Device name and username cannot be blank.

abort.wrong_device: This is a different NVX device. Add it as a separate integration.
abort.identity_unavailable: The original device identity is unknown. Reconnect using its original address first, or add the device as a separate entry.
abort.unsupported_config: This entry cannot be reconfigured here. Configure one device per entry.

data.enable_preview_camera: Enable preview camera (fetches a live JPEG snapshot from each device)
